Kyla Park: Hey y'all! I'm Kyla — starting today on infra product. Super excited to meet everyone. I live in PST, bring an overwatered monstera, and my go-to karaoke song is 'Wannabe' :scream:. Coffee or tea to fuel onboarding? :coffee: vs :tea:
Sam R: Welcome Kyla!! :tada: Coffee here. Slack me if you want a tour later — I'm at desk D12.
Tanya Lee: Hi Kyla — welcome! I'm in EST, happy to grab lunch next week. Also +1 to karaoke. :microphone: 
Marco Diaz: Welcome!! There's a plant swap every Friday in the kitchen. You'll fit right in. Also we have a 'secret snack' drawer (don't tell finance) :shushing_face: 
Ben O'Connor: Hey Kyla — onboarding checklist: https://internal.redwood.com/onboarding/checklist (DM me if anything missing). FYI badge pickup is near main reception — say 'Redwood' and they'll buzz you in. /badge
Jess: Woo welcome! If you like boba there's a good spot 2 blocks from the office — lunch crew meets 12:30 today near the big ficus (🌿).
Kyla Park: Thanks everyone! I'll swing by reception after standup. Also for the poll: coffee please :coffee: — strong opinions welcome.
Sam R: :thumbsup: noted. We'll save you some coffee vouchers. Also FYI team trivia tonight 7pm if you're up for it.
Tanya Lee: :balloon: trivia is fun, bring your A-game
Marco Diaz: @Kyla Park I'll add you to the plant-swap thread. See you at lunch!
welcome-bot: Welcome Kyla Park! Your account has been added to #new-hires, #infra, and #lunch-plans. Complete your checklist to get full access.
Kyla Park: Thanks @welcome-bot and everyone — feel really welcomed already :heart:
